module_import
probes.source:
import module java.base;
class Probe { int f(boolean x) { return x ? 1 : 0; } }

probes.name: constructor_super_prologue
probes.source:
class Parent { Parent(int x) {} }
class Coverage extends Parent { Coverage(int x) { if (x < 0) x = -x; super(x); if (x > 1) System.out.println(x); } }

probes.name: constructor_this_prologue
probes.source: class Coverage { Coverage(int x) { if (x < 0) x = -x; this(x, true); } Coverage(int x, boolean unused) { if (x > 1) System.out.println(x); } }

probes.name: parenthesized_assignment
probes.source: class Coverage { int f(boolean flag) { int value = 0; (value) = flag ? 1 : 2; (value) += 1; return value; } }

probes.name: leading_zero_float
probes.source: class Coverage { double f(boolean flag) { double value = 043F + 09e1 + 00D; return flag ? value : 0; } }

qualified_record_pattern
probes.source:
class Outer { record Pair(String text) {} }
class Coverage { int f(Object value) { if (value instanceof Outer.Pair(String text)) return text.length(); return 0; } }
